en: First, to build our scene, you need to draw the symbol of Azarothe on the floor (⇀‸↼‶)
Huh… Aza what?? What does that look like?
Like a circle on the floor with- WE DON'T HAVE TIME, JUST DO YOUR BEST (╬ಠ益ಠ)
You're really in a hurry to play, I'll do something like this… hm.. done, what else?
Now place the five candles *insert the name of the candles* around and LIGHT THEM ಠ益ಠ)凸
Light? But Grandma said not to play with fire, I might get burned.
FORGET ABOUT THAT, now put the sand of souls and place me in the middle of the circle, I'LL FIND A WAY OUT ((╬◣﹏◢))
The eggwatch begins to tremble in the middle of the circle and all the candles are lit in order, the room begins to get hotter.
Hmm... you're scaring me, I don't want to play with you anymore.
His grandparents jump in front, unintentionally entering the circle. A bright light emanates from the fire, blinding his vision. The spirit is transforming in front of him while giving an evil laugh.
His grandparents begin to scream, but now, from inside the eggwatch:

Finally... After so long I managed to escape this prison. Did you really think that two dying old humans could contain me forever? HAHAHAHA Filthy child, just like your parents, I will personally carry you to HELL!! HAHAHAHAHA
While the demon's soul begins to materialize, you grab the eggwatch.
RUN BOY, GO AWAY (ಥ﹏ಥ) value your life and get out the door, don't worry about us, run and find a convent or church to protect yourself from him.
NO, EXORCISE THE DEMON (ᗒᗣᗕ)՞ if you don't do that, we'll be trapped forever, this spell is too strong and can only be undone by exorcising this demon.
